definitions.gloss: rice bran; outer husk removed in milling
definitions.explanation: The outer layer of brown rice that is removed during milling to produce white rice. Used extensively in traditional Japanese pickling and as a fertilizer.

examples.japanese: {糠|ぬか}で{漬物|つけもの}を{作|つく}る。
{糠床|ぬかどこ}を{毎日|まいにち}{かき混|かきま}ぜる。
examples.english: Stir the rice bran bed every day.

examples.japanese: {玄米|げんまい}を{精米|せいまい}すると{糠|ぬか}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: When you mill brown rice, rice bran comes out.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {糠漬|ぬかづ}け: nukazuke (vegetables pickled in rice bran); also written {糠漬|ぬかづ}け
- {糠床|ぬかどこ}: rice bran pickling bed
- {米糠|こめぬか}: rice bran (more formal term)
- {糠油|ぬかあぶら}: rice bran oil

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ふすま: wheat bran (from wheat milling; not from rice)
